title: CBSE CTET September 2020  Correction / Edit Form
vacancyDetails: Eligibility test for Paper I (Classes I-V) and Paper II (Classes VI-VIII); no recruitment vacancy count is applicable.
qualification: Paper I: Senior Secondary with the required marks plus a qualifying Elementary Education / B.El.Ed / Special Education diploma. Paper II: Graduation or Post-Graduation with the required marks plus D.El.Ed / B.Ed / B.El.Ed / B.A.-B.Sc.Ed or another qualification listed in the official eligibility code.
ageLimit: No fixed upper age limit is specified for appearing in CTET; verify the current information bulletin for eligibility and certificate conditions.
applicationFee: Single Paper: General / OBC / EWS ₹1,000; SC / ST / PH ₹500. Both Paper I and Paper II: General / OBC / EWS ₹1,200; SC / ST / PH ₹600. Pay through debit card, credit card, net banking or e-Challan.
selectionProcess: Online eligibility test in Paper I or Paper II; qualifying status and certificate validity are governed by the CTET information bulletin.
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, identity proof, address details, educational certificates and category / disability certificate where applicable.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official CTET application portal
2. Read the September 2026 information bulletin and select Paper I, Paper II or both
3. Complete registration and enter personal, academic and category details
4. Upload the photograph, signature and required documents
5. Pay the examination fee through the available official payment mode
6. Review every field, submit the form and save the confirmation page
7. Use the official portal for correction, admit card, answer key and result updates
shortDescription: CBSE CTET September 2026 is the teacher eligibility examination for candidates targeting Paper I (Classes I-V), Paper II (Classes VI-VIII), or both papers. Check the official bulletin for the complete eligibility code and current examination instructions.
content:
CBSE CTET September 2026 covers two teacher eligibility papers: Paper I for Classes I to V and Paper II for Classes VI to VIII. The page keeps the official dates, fee and resources in their dedicated sections, while the paper-wise eligibility code is summarized below.

Paper I: Classes I to V

  1. Senior Secondary or equivalent with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in a two-year Diploma in Elementary Education.
  2. Senior Secondary or equivalent with at least 45% marks and passed or appearing in a two-year Diploma in Elementary Education under the applicable NCTE regulations.
  3. Senior Secondary or equivalent with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in a four-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed).
  4. Senior Secondary or equivalent with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in a two-year Diploma in Education (Special Education).

Paper II: Classes VI to VIII

  1. Graduation and passed or appearing in the final year of a two-year Diploma in Elementary Education.
  2. At least 50% marks in Graduation or Post-Graduation and passed or appearing in B.Ed.
  3. Graduation with at least 45% marks and passed or appearing in B.Ed under the applicable NCTE regulations.
  4. Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in four-year B.El.Ed or B.A./B.Sc.Ed.
  5. Graduation with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in B.Ed (Special Education), or another route listed in the official bulletin.
  6. Post-Graduation with at least 55% marks and passed or appearing in three-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.

Eligibility codes, subject combinations and the final interpretation of the rules are controlled by the official CTET information bulletin.

faqs.question: Which papers are available in CTET September 2026?
faqs.answer: Paper I is for Classes I to V, Paper II is for Classes VI to VIII, and candidates may apply for both papers if they meet the applicable eligibility conditions.

faqs.question: Where can the CTET September 2026 bulletin be downloaded?
faqs.answer: Use the official brochure link in the Important Links section and confirm the latest version on ctet.nic.in.

faqs.question: Which fee applies to CTET September 2026?
faqs.answer: The fee depends on the category and whether the candidate selects one paper or both papers. The complete category-wise fee is shown in the Application Fee section.
